note: Phase 10 release-readiness matrix. Machine-readable companion to docs/RELEASE_GATE.md. PASS is only used with direct evidence; owner-only and production-lock items stay BLOCKED_*; unchecked items stay NOT_ASSESSED. Status vocabulary: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT_IMPLEMENTED | NOT_ASSESSED | NOT_APPLICABLE | BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION | BLOCKED_PRODUCTION_LOCK.
verdictBasis: Thirteen of seventeen gates are PASS with direct evidence re-verified on 2026-10-18. Licensing approval (G6), production-data authorization (G8), owner decisions (G16 — 4 of 5 pending) and final production eligibility (G17) are mandatory and unresolved. No technical defect remains open inside the authorized Dataset scope.

gates.title: Repository integrity
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Clean tracked tree at verification; identity matches declared branch/HEAD; no stray artifacts
evidence: git status --porcelain empty on arena/a4caaeb8-drobon-dataset at baseline ed599c6 (2026-10-18)
working branch == origin/main at baseline; no upstream configured for the session branch

gates.title: Schema correctness
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Every advisory/pack/asset/audience file validates against the executable specs
gates.verificationCommand: npm run validate && npm run validate:packs && npm run validate:assets && npm run validate:audiences && npm run validate:cwe && npm run validate:sources

gates.title: Rule quality and test coverage
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Every rule has >=1 positive and >=1 negative executed test; ReDoS lint enforced; semantic metadata rules enforced
gates.verificationCommand: npm run validate:packs && node scripts/test-packs.mjs && node scripts/test-assets.mjs

gates.title: Data identity and dedup
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Identity keys unique; shards collapse to one item; 0 conflict tuples; retired IDs reserved and pinned
evidence: 26 retired reservations pinned by the consistency suite

gates.title: Provenance completeness
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Every real record carries source+sourceUrl+retrievedAt; original content has git authorship evidence
gates.verificationCommand: npm run validate && npm run provenance
evidence: 4/100 upstream existence spot-check 2026-10-16 (sample only, not 100% verification)

gates.title: Licensing/redistribution approval
gates.acceptanceCriteria: LICENSE grant exists OR every production-bound source has owner-signed redistribution decision; matrix licenseStatus flipped with evidence
evidence: 4 of 5 owner decisions pending; ORIGINAL_CONTENT APPROVED 2026-10-17 but no grant file or ownership evidence exists
blockingFindings: F-05: license grant absent; redistribution UNVERIFIED for GHSA/OSV
gates.ownerAction: Choose license grant(s); confirm per-source redistribution (LICENSE_DECISION_RECORD.md §4)

gates.title: Source verification
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Provenance fields complete on every real record AND sampled upstream existence checks documented with date and sample size
gates.verificationCommand: npm run validate && (sampled gh api /advisories/<id> spot-checks)
evidence: 4/100 live sample 2026-10-16: GHSA-24ch-f2g6-9hhh, GHSA-2gpf-2492-q9jh, GHSA-48qf-xh34-q73r, GHSA-x937-hj6v-793p all exist and match package/severity/range
blockingFindings: Sample size 4/100 — 96 records not re-verified against upstream this run

gates.title: Production-data authorization
gates.acceptanceCriteria: All four INGESTION_GATES SATISFIED with written evidence before any catalog expansion
gates.ownerAction: Written stage approval (GATE-1), license decision (GATE-2), reviewer capacity (GATE-3), app provider design (GATE-4)

gates.title: Documentation consistency
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Every stated count recomputes from files; drift fails CI; license-field semantics documented
evidence: stale counts corrected in README/CORPUS_GAP_REPORT/CAPABILITY_COVERAGE/SCA_RULE_SCHEMA_PROPOSAL/REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX and the current-state matrices (2026-10-18)

gates.title: Security-toolchain hardening
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Importer/generator/validator attack surface reviewed; safe filename handling; leak scan clean; CI least-privilege; no network in tests
gates.verificationCommand: node scripts/test-importers.mjs && node scripts/test-consistency.mjs && npm run validate:packs
evidence: filename injection fixture rejected (GHSA id grammar before write)
leak scan clean outside audited secrets zone
importer tests use injected fetch (no network)

gates.title: Reproducibility
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Generation+validation deterministic across two runs in a fresh copy; outputs byte-identical
evidence: node scripts/test-determinism.mjs: 5/5 PASS (two fresh copies, generation+validation logs byte-identical)
regenerated trees byte-identical and identical to the checked-in tree (idempotent)
whole-tree sha256 digest reproducible across runs (the value is printed by the runner and changes with any tree edit by design; it is not pinned here)

gates.title: Full regression tests
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Entire npm test + all validators green on this exact tree, exit 0
gates.verificationCommand: npm test && npm run validate && npm run validate:sources && npm run validate:corpus && npm run validate:packs && npm run validate:audiences && npm run validate:cwe && npm run validate:matrix && npm run test:vectors
evidence: 2026-10-18: npm test exit 0 — all 14 runners PASS (15,730 assertions before the current-state gate was added; the final run total is recorded in docs/DATASET_COMPLETION_AUDIT_2026-10-18.md)
validators: validate 103 files, sources 1, corpus 3, packs 1106, assets 2166, audiences 1114, cwe 63, matrix recomputed, vectors 16/16 — all PASS, exit 0

gates.title: Dataset/App separation

evidence: repository contains data + tooling only (SCOPE.md seam inventory)
